title: Qabre nabi pe roke ye shabbir ne kaha
body:
1. QABRE NABI PE ROKE YE SHABBEER NE KAHA
NANA GALA KATANE JATA HOON KARBALA
NANA SALAM AKHRI LE LO HUSAIN KA..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. NANA SAWAL KARTA BAYYAT KA AB YAZEED
NANA SUKUN SE RAHNE NAHI DETA AB YAZEED
NANA YAZEED KHOON KA PAYASA MERE HUWA..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. NANA SAFER ME SATH HAI BACHCHE WA NAUJAWAN
NANA SAWAR HO CHUKI MAHMIL ME BIBIYAN
HAMRAH KAFILE KE HAI ABBAS E BAWAFA..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. NANA MAI KAISE JAOON TERI QABR CHOD KAR
ROTE RAHE HUSAIN YE KAHKAR MAZAR PER
NANA LAGA LO SINE SE UTHKAR MUJHE ZARA..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. NANA LAHED ME APNI SULA LIJIYE MUJHE
PAHLU ME APNE NANA JAGHAH DIJIYE MUJHE
DUSHAMAN HAMARA SARA ZAMANA YE HO CHUKA..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. BACHPAN ME MERE NAAZ UTHAIYA THA AAPNE
KANDHO PE APNE MUJHKO BITHYA THA AAPNE
HO JAOON KAISE APPKI TURBAT SE MAI JUDA..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. NANA YE JANTA HOON KI PALAT KER NA AOONGA
KARBOBALA KE DAST ME BASTI BASOONGA
KHANJAR SE SHIMR KATEGA SUKHA GALA MERA..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. QABRE NABI LARAZ GAI SUNKAR YE SHAIH KE BAIN
ANE LAGI LAHED SE SADA AE MERE HUSAIN
AB JA MERE HUSAIN HAFIZ HAI HAFIZ KHUDA TERA
<<DIVIDER>>
9. HANGAME ZIBHA LAL TU PANI NA PAEGA
MERE HUSAIN TASHNA TU DUNIYA SE JAIEGA
PANI TUJHE PILAIENGE JANNAT ME MURTAZA..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
10. TERO PE TEER KHAIGA JIS DAM MERA HUSAIN
AEGA KAISE US GHADI QALBE NABI KO CHAIN
YEH SOCH KAR LAHED ME TALBTE HAI MUSTAFA..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
11. ZAINAB KO TERE QAIDI BANENGE ASHKIYA
PHIR USKO SA R BARAHNA PHIRAIENGE ASHKIYA
NOKE SENA PE HOGA MERE LAL SAR TERA..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
12. SENE PE SONE WALI KE DURRE LAGAINGE
USKO YATEEM JAN KE AADA SATAENGE
USKE BHI SAR SE CHINENGE AHLE JAFA RIDA..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
13. SUN KE SUKHAN YE NANA KE SHAIH NE KAHA QAMAR
NANA HAMR E SATH CHALO QABR CHOD KAR
RAHIYEGA NANA SATH MERE AAP HAR JAGAH..(2)
